content.hebrew: אֶהֱבוּ אֶת־יוי, דּוֹר יְשָׁרִים,
content.english: Love Adonai, generation of the upright,

content.hebrew: הִתְקוֹשְׁשׁוּ וָקֽוֹשּׁוּ, וְאֶחֱזוּ צֶֽדֶק וּמִשְׁפָּט וּמֵישָׁרִים.
content.transliteration: Hitḳosheshu vaḳosh’shu, ve’eḥezu tsedeḳ umishpat mesharim.
content.english: Gather yourselves, yes, gather, and take hold of righteousness, justness, and uprightness.

content.hebrew: רְצוֹן אֵל עֲשׂוּ, וּתְנוּ בַּשְּׁעָרִים
content.english: Do God’s will, and place at the gates

content.hebrew: נֶאֶמְנֵי לֵב – שֹׁפְטִים וְשֹׁטְרִים.
content.english: Judges and officers, who are faithful in their hearts.

content.hebrew: בְּיֹֽשֶׁר יִרְדְּפוּ, וְלֹא יִהְיוּ פָּנִים מַכִּירִים.
content.transliteration: Beyosher yirdefu, velo yihyu panim makkirim.
content.english: They should pursue [justice] uprightly, and not show partiality.

content.hebrew: נְשֹׂא שֹֽׁחַד יִמְאָֽסוּ, פֶּן יְמַשְּׁשׁוּ קִיר כְּמוֹ עִוְרִים,
content.transliteration: Neso shoḥad yim’asu, pen yemash’sheshu ḳir kemo ‘ivrim,
content.english: They should despise the taking of bribes, lest they fumble around walls like the blind,

content.hebrew: וִיסַלְּפוּ דִּבְרֵי צַדִּיקִים וּבְרוּרִים.
content.english: And pervert the words of the righteous and the blameless.

content.hebrew: וְיַשְׁבִּֽיתוּ מַצֵּבָה וְחַמָּנִים וַאֲשֵׁרִים;
content.english: [The Israelites] must get rid of all standing-pillars, ḥammanim, and asherim;
content.comments: Ḥammanim and asherim. Items associated with idolatry.

content.hebrew: וְעֹבֵד צְבָא שָׁמַֽיִם, וּמִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה לֵאלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים,
content.transliteration: Ve‘oved tseva shamayim, umishtaḥavē le’Elohim aḥerim,
content.english: And whoever worships the host of heaven, and prostrates to foreign deities,

content.hebrew: יִסָּקֵל, עַל־פִּי עֵדִים כְּשֵׁרִים.
content.english: Shall be stoned, according to the word of [two] valid witnesses.

content.hebrew: וּפִלְאֵי מִשְׁפָּטִים חֲמוּרִים,
content.english: Extraordinary [cases] of severe laws,

content.hebrew: בֵּין דִּין לְדִין – רִיבוֹת דְּבָרִים,
content.english: Whatever the case—quarrels regarding anything,

content.hebrew: יוּבְאוּ לְחַכְמֵי מֶחְקָרִים.
content.english: Shall be brought to wise sages.

content.hebrew: וּמֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא יִהְיֶה מֵאֲנָשִׁים נָכְרִים.
content.transliteration: Umelekh Yisra’el lo yihyē me’anashim nokhrim.
content.english: The king of Israel shall not be from foreign men.

content.hebrew: וְלֹא יִמָּצְאוּ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל יַלְדֵיהֶם בָּאֵשׁ מַעֲבִירִים,
content.transliteration: Velo yimmatse’u beYisra’el yaldehem ba’esh ma‘avirim,
content.english: There shall not be found among Israel those who pass their children through fire,

content.hebrew: וְשֹׁאֵל אוֹב וְיִדְּעֹנִי, וְחֹבֵר חֲבָרִים.
content.english: Consult ghosts or lots, or whisper charms.

content.hebrew: נָבִיא מִבֵּינָיו יָקִים יוי, מַגִּיד נִסְתָּרִים.
content.transliteration: Navi mibbanav yaḳim Adonai, maggid nistarim.
content.english: Adonai will raise a prophet from among them, who will tell secret things.

content.hebrew: וּבְמִלְחֶֽמֶת רְשׁוּת לֹא יֵצְאוּ חֲמִשָּׁה נִסְפָּרִים,
content.transliteration: Uvmilḥemet reshut lo yetse’u ḥamish’sha nisparim,
content.english: To a volitional battle, the five enumerated shall not go;

content.hebrew: כִּי בְמִלְחֶֽמֶת חוֹבָה יֵצֵא חָתָן מֵחֲדָרִים.
content.transliteration: Ki vemilḥmet ḥova yetsē ḥatan meḥadarim.
content.english: But to an obligatory battle, [even] a groom shall go from his [marital] chamber.

content.hebrew: וְלִקְרֹא בְשָׁלוֹם לְכָל־עָרִים,
content.english: [The Israelites] shall call to [offer] peace to all cities,

content.hebrew: וְאִם לֹא יַשְׁלִֽימוּ – יֻכּוּ הַזְּכָרִים.
content.english: And if [the inhabitants of the city] do not make peace, then all the males shall be smitten.

content.hebrew: וְחָלָל נִמְצָא בֵּין הַכְּפָרִים,
content.english: [If] a corpse is found between towns,

content.hebrew: עִיר הַקְּרוֹבָה בֶּחָלָל – זְקֵנֶֽיהָ יִקְחוּ עֶגְלַת בְּקָרִים,
content.english: The elders of the city nearest to the corpse shall take a female calf of the cattle,

content.hebrew: לֹא מָשְׁכָה בְעֹל, וְאִם הֵרִים.
content.english: Which has never pulled a yoke, even if it has lifted one.

content.hebrew: וְהַשֵּׁם יְבַעֵר דַּם הַנָּקִי, אִם נַעֲשֶׂה דַּרְכֵי בָרִים.
content.transliteration: Vehash’shem yeva‘er dam hannaḳi, im na‘asē darkhē varim.
content.english: And the Name will purge the blood of the innocent [victim], if we act in ways of purity.
content.comments: The Name. Hebrew ha-shem, an epithet for God.

content.hebrew: אֵין כָּאֵל, יְשֻׁרוּן! וּמִי כָמֹֽהוּ מוֹרֶה מִמּוֹרִים?
content.transliteration: En ka’El Yeshurun! Umi khamohu morē mimmorim?
content.english: There is none like God, O Jeshurun! What teacher, of [all] teachers, is like Him?

content.hebrew: נְשַׁבְּחֶֽנּוּ בִּזְמִירוֹת וְשִׁירִים –
content.english: Let us praise Him with hymns and songs—

content.hebrew: קהל: כִּי גָבַהּ בִּצְדָקָה, מַשְׁפִּיל וּמֵרִים.
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Ki ḡavah bitsdaḳa, mashpil umerim.
content.english: Cong. For He is lofty in justice; He brings down and raises up.

content.hebrew: חזן: וַיִּגְבַּ֛הּ יו֥י צְבָא֖וֹת בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט וְהָאֵל֙ הַקָּד֔וֹשׁ נִקְדָּ֖שׁ בִּצְדָקָֽה:
content.transliteration: Ḥazzan: Vayyiḡbah Adonai tseva’ot bammishpat veha’el haḳḳadosh niḳdash bitsdaḳa:
content.english: Cantor. And Adonai Ẓeva’oth is towering high in justice; and the holy God is sanctified in righteousness. (Isa. 5:16)
content.comments: Adonai Ẓeva’oth. A common name for God in Scripture; traditional English: “the Lord of Hosts.”

content.hebrew: קהל: קָד֧וֹשׁ ׀ קָד֛וֹשׁ קָד֖וֹשׁ יו֥י צְבָא֑וֹת מְלֹ֥א כָל־הָאָ֖רֶץ כְּבוֹדֽוֹ:
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Ḳadosh, ḳadosh ḳadosh Adonai tseva’ot melo khol ha’arets kevodo:
content.english: Cong. Holy, holy, holy is Adonai Ẓeva’oth; the entire world is full of His Glory. (Isa. 6:3)
